_comment: A set FAMILY in catalog.json is mutable authoring intent. A RELEASE is an
immutable, digest-identified revision of it, and a profile pins the release,
never the family. (familyId, version) resolves to exactly one releaseDigest
for all time, and a version is never reused - not after deprecation, not
state is the only mutable part of a record: Released -> Deprecated ->
Retired. Changing it never touches the manifest bytes, the digest, or the
review. Deprecation restricts new adoption; retirement restricts execution;
neither restricts explanation of an old run.
There is no blockedByRollout here: Released IS the eligibility. A second
boolean could disagree with the state, and the permissive reading would win.
and are digested exactly as ADR-0019 section 4 fixes.
